title: A badge unlock animation
summary: A trophy badge pops in, bursts with light rays and confetti, and settles with a glow, all on a web page.
brief: A web page for an achievement unlocked: a trophy badge springs onto the screen, then rays, confetti and a lingering glow follow in that order, each with its own timing. A Replay button runs the sequence from the start every time, and everything is drawn in code.

prompts.text: Make me a web page with a polished badge unlock animation: a shiny gold trophy on a bright badge pops in, bursts with light rays and confetti, then settles with a soft glow, and a Replay button. Check in a browser that the effects never block the button and that it plays the animation again every time you click it. Draw it all in code with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, build it in a new folder inside the current project folder, open it in my browser when it is done, and ask me before you install or load anything.
prompts.label: A trophy badge that unlocks with confetti

action.label: Make a badge animation in Atu
